The project's own terms (guidelines §6.6); the corpus ../renderings.md (§0–§9; §9 fixed for this run) binds first. Lemmas: ETCSL / ePSD2 citation forms. "Lines" = ETCSL labels. Hebrew as in the > lines (plene, niqqud only where the line has it). Written from the drafted lines on 2026-10-22 and re-checked against them by script: every "Check" string (niqqud stripped) is found in the > line of every listed line.
